integrity: The infinite claim is proved analytically from an invariant-subspace decomposition, exact quotient factorization, exact spectral-projector entries, and the published Laplacian peak-transfer parity criterion. Finite exact-arithmetic replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies root-to-child Laplacian peak state transfer only. It does not classify other vertex pairs, adjacency dynamics, or all generalized Bethe trees. The transfer distance is one and the peak probability decays as the family grows.
title: An infinite non-star tree family with Laplacian peak state transfer
